Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of NHM Thiruvananthapuram to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the NHM Thiruvananthapuram General Duty Attendant recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form for the NHM Thiruvananthapuram General Duty Attendant posts is 06-08-2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the minimum qualification required for the General Duty Attendant post?
faq.answer: The minimum educational qualification required for the General Duty Attendant post is 8th Pass.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the General Duty Attendant position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the General Duty Attendant post is 40 years.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are available for the General Duty Attendant post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 10 vacancies announced for the General Duty Attendant post by NHM Thiruvananthapuram.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the General Duty Attendant role?
faq.answer: The salary for the General Duty Attendant position is Rs. 450 Per Day.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply for this recruitment through the Online mode only.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for the NHM Thiruvananthapuram General Duty Attendant recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the General Duty Attendant posts?
faq.answer: The selection of candidates for the General Duty Attendant posts will be based on an Interview.

faq.question: Q9. What is the official website for NHM Thiruvananthapuram?
faq.answer: The official website for National Health Mission Thiruvananthapuram is www.arogyakeralam.gov.in.
